snippet.title: A Tale of Little Berry Forest
snippet.description:
A Tale of Little Berry Forest

Google Store :  https://goo.gl/JnLz24
App Store :  https://goo.gl/Z79KAq

- Introduction of game -

◈ 100% handmade game ◈

All image work in the game is not computer graphics work.
I used oil pastels to draw one by one with my hands!

◈ A little slow, simple but warm emotional healing game ◈

Among exciting and fast-paced games,
Discover the small charms that are slowly and slowly flowing.
Pictures and music that seemed like a fairy tale. Stories of individual characters
Feel the game's generous mind to share a small but many things.

◈ A delicious game where you can feel the warmth◈

Meet fun mini games and cute dishes
It's not expensive food in a colorful restaurant.
We have put in a game of homemade cooking.

○ 3 hours of play time
○ Optimized for 16: 9 screen
○ Support for Korean, Chinese, English, Japanese and Spanish
○ No ads or in-app purchases
